title: Lentil salad with grilled halloumi and roast vegetables
steps: Cook the lentils in water for 20–25 minutes until just tender and drain.
Preheat the oven to 220 °C, cut the courgette, pepper and onion into chunks, toss with 2 tsp oil and roast for 20 minutes.
Slice the halloumi and fry in a dry pan for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Toss the lentils, vegetables and rocket with lemon juice, the remaining oil, salt and mint and top with the halloumi.
